name: Twilio Segment
description: Twilio Segment is a customer data platform for collecting, governing, unifying, and activating first-party customer data across sources and destinations. Its current Unify and Engage products include identity-resolved profiles, computed traits, audiences, journeys, and downstream activation; the historical Personas name is retained in this provider slug.
agentUseSummary: Add a workspace-scoped Segment Public API token and bind one exact Space plus US or EU region; agents can read only a redacted first-page audience readiness aggregate.

credentialRequirements.name: SEGMENT_PUBLIC_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Segment Public API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated least-privilege Public API token in the exact Segment Workspace. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to the selected official Segment API region.

credentialRequirements.name: SEGMENT_SPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Segment Space ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact Unify/Engage Space at connection time; agents cannot choose another Space.

credentialRequirements.name: SEGMENT_API_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Segment API region (us or eu1)
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select us for api.segmentapis.com or eu1 for eu1.api.segmentapis.com; Relay never accepts runtime origins.

capabilities.label: Read audience readiness summary
capabilities.description: Aggregate the first 25 audiences by enabled/live state, product type, and compute cadence with all identity, definitions, members, and sizes excluded.

approvalRequired.label: Get Segment Personas audience readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only bounded aggregate readiness counts plus total and next-page presence for the exact bound Space.

blocked.label: Access audience identity, definition, or size
blocked.description: Audience IDs, names, keys, descriptions, FQL definitions, membership sizes, historical options, creators, timestamps, and pagination cursors remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, members, traits, or identifiers
blocked.description: Profiles, users, accounts, members, traits, events, emails, phones, user/customer/device/advertising IDs, identity graphs, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access destinations, sources, schedules, or activation
blocked.description: Audience consumers, schedules, journeys, destinations, sources, warehouses, activation settings, delivery state, and downstream audiences remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer Segment
blocked.description: Audience previews, forced runs, create/update/delete, schedules, filters, profiles, traits, sources, destinations, tokens, roles, workspaces, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary Spaces, regions, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, searches, includes, cursors, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded audience readiness read requires approval; identity, profiles, definitions, members, activation, writes, raw APIs, pagination, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; workspace/space/region binding, token authority, redaction, caps, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed Space-bound identity-free Segment Audience readiness wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed Space-bound Segment wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Segment Audience Public API access requires an eligible Unify/Engage customer Workspace, Audience feature entitlement, exact Space and region, and a Public API token with appropriate Profiles/Engage read permission.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin confirms entitlement, creates a dedicated least-privilege Public API token, supplies the exact Space/region binding, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Segment documents workspace-entitled Audience list/get/create/update/delete, previews, forced runs, schedules and consumers; List Audiences uses a Space ID, token pagination, rich identity/definition/member-size fields, and a 60-request/minute limit.
Segment documents workspace-scoped Public API tokens, permission assignment, HTTPS-only Bearer authentication, and separate tokens per Workspace.
Segment documents distinct US api.segmentapis.com and EU eu1.api.segmentapis.com origins and customer-generated Public API tokens.
Segment documents pagination.count/cursor inputs and current/next/previous/totalEntries metadata; Relay fixes count 25 and never follows cursors.
Twilio Segment states that historical Personas is now part of the Twilio Engage product offering.

securityNotes: The assigned Segment Personas slug resolves to one Twilio Segment provider and one connection state.
Relay encrypts the workspace-scoped Public API token, exact Space ID, and region binding; the token is sent only as a Bearer header to the selected official Segment Public API origin.
Relay allowlists only GET /spaces/{bound-space}/audiences?pagination.count=25, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps responses at 1 MB, and never follows pagination.

Output contains only page/total presence and aggregate enabled/live/type/cadence counts; audience IDs, names, definitions, sizes, members, identifiers, profiles, traits, schedules, consumers, destinations, and cursor values are excluded.

Audience previews, forced runs, create/update/delete, profiles, traits, sources, destinations, filters, raw APIs, arbitrary inputs, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider setup, entitlement confirmation, token/role creation, Space selection, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
